events.headline: UN ANALISTA INTERNACIONAL EXPLICÓ EN DETALLE QUÉ PASA CON EL ULTIMÁTUM DE TRUMP
events.detail: En diálogo con LN+, el analista Andrés Repetto profundizó en la decisión del mandatario estadounidense de extender el plazo para alcanzar una resolución definitiva con Irán y el estrecho de Ormuz

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TRUMP WARNS OF ATTACKS AS HORMUZ DEAL DEADLINE NEARS
events.detail: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth says US forces are carrying out more strikes on Iran than any day since start of war.

events.headline: IRÁN LLAMA A JÓVENES ATLETAS A FORMAR CADENAS HUMANAS ALREDEDOR DE LAS PLANTAS D
events.detail: Es una respuesta extrema a la amenaza de Trump de bombardear mañana infraestructura clave para que Teherán libere el estrecho de Ormuz

events.headline: CLOCK TICKS ON TRUMP'S IRAN ULTIMATUM WITH LITTLE SIGN OF BREAKTHROUGH
events.detail: The US president is in a delicate political position as the final hours to Tuesday's deadline for Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz tick down.

events.headline: TRUMP THREATENS TO TAKE OUT IRAN IN 'ONE NIGHT' IF NO DEAL BEFORE DEADLINE
events.detail: The US president wants Tehran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy route, before his Tuesday deadline.

events.headline: TRUMP SAYS US COULD CHARGE FOR STRAIT OF HORMUZ PASSAGE AMID IRAN WAR
events.detail: US president says Washington, as the 'winner' of the war, has a 'concept' for charging a toll in the strategic waterway.
